# Vib Apps Engine — Complete Single-URL AI Master Specification (`llms-full.txt`, `schemaVersion: 1`)

> **Single-Fetch AI URL:** `https://apps.vib.tools/llms-full.txt`
> **Root Index:** `https://apps.vib.tools/llms.txt`
> **Frozen JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12):** `https://apps.vib.tools/schemas/vibtools-app.schema.json`
> **Compact Spec:** `https://apps.vib.tools/vib-apps-engine/llms.txt`
> **Full A–Z Setup Guide:** `https://apps.vib.tools/vib-apps-engine/vibtools-app-config.md`
> **AI Playbook & Prompt:** `https://apps.vib.tools/vib-apps-engine/ai-guide.md`
> **Storefront:** `https://apps.vib.tools` | **CLI & Download Router:** `https://get.vib.tools`

---

## 1. System Purpose & Zero-Config Repo-URL Auto-Collection
`vib-apps-hub` is a zero-build, zero-database app store and PowerShell CLI router. Any application repository becomes a live marketplace listing simply by:
1. Adding a `.vibtools/apps/` folder inside the app's GitHub repository.
2. Adding ONLY the GitHub repository URL (`"https://github.com/owner/repo"`) to `registry.json` in `vib-apps-hub`.

### Auto-Collection Pipeline (Step-by-Step)
1. **Parse & Deduplicate (`parseRepoIdentifier` + `getRegistry`):** Accepts `"https://github.com/owner/repo"`, `.git`, `/tree/<branch>`, `"owner/repo"`, or `{ repo, branch, featured }`. Deduplicates by `repo@branch`.
2. **Fetch Manifest (`fetchAppConfig`):** Queries GitHub Contents API for `.vibtools/apps/app.config.json` (404 fallback: `.vibtools/app.config.json`) with 300s Cloudflare Edge Cache (`GITHUB_TOKEN` supports private repos server-side).
3. **Strict Validation (`validateAppConfig`):** Enforces 100% Frozen Schema v1 parity (`additionalProperties: false`, lowercase `slug`, exact `latest` key match, valid `https://` URLs, real calendar `YYYY-MM-DD`, 64-hex `sha256`, unique `platforms`/`architectures`, traversal/scheme guards on `installer` and `docs`). Invalid configs return `422` and are excluded from the catalog.
4. **Auto-Discovery (`resolveAppBySlug` + Mode A Slug Deduplication):** Automatically matches the app's `slug` from `app.config.json` even when the GitHub repository name differs from `slug`. Deduplicates duplicate slugs across repos.
5. **Live Serving:**
   - `GET https://apps.vib.tools/api/apps` -> Catalog grid cards & categories.
   - `GET https://apps.vib.tools/api/apps?slug=<slug>` -> Full metadata + sanitized `features.md` & `changelog.md`.
   - `irm "https://get.vib.tools/<slug>[/<version>]" | iex` -> Streams version's installer script (`versions[ver].installer` -> root `installer` -> repo defaults; supports R2 HTTPS URLs or repo paths) with `$APP_SLUG`, `$APP_VERSION`, and `$APP_NAME` prepended.
   - `https://get.vib.tools/<slug>[/<version>]?download=1` -> Browser-downloadable version-injected installer script attachment (`Content-Disposition: attachment`) for manual inspection & execution.
   - `https://get.vib.tools/dl/<slug>[/<version>]` -> `302` redirect to verified HTTPS binary URL on a trusted host.

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Setup Matrix (Task, Purpose & Usage)

| Step | File / Action | What It Does (Task) | Purpose (Why Needed) | How It Is Used |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | Create `.vibtools/apps/` | Isolates all Vib Apps Engine files in one folder at repo root. | Keeps marketplace files separate from app source code. | Auto-scanned by `fetchAppConfig()`, `fetchAppInstaller()`, `fetchAppDoc()`. |
| **2** | Create `app.config.json` | Declares Frozen v1 metadata, versions, checksums, docs & installers. | Single source of truth for catalog cards, version picker & routing. | Validated by `validateAppConfig()` (`schemaVersion: 1`). |
| **3** | Configure Master `installer.ps1` | Downloads and installs `$APP_VERSION` cleanly in PowerShell (UTF-8 without BOM). | Powers one-line CLI (`irm ... \| iex`) and manual script download (`?download=1`). | **Recommended (Clean Repo):** Host on R2 (`https://dl.vib.tools/<App>/installer.ps1`) and reference in root `installer.script`, or place at `.vibtools/apps/installer.ps1`. |
| **4** | Add per-version `installer` (Optional) | Overrides root installer for specific versions only. | Lets legacy/beta versions use different install scripts or R2 URLs. | Set `versions.<ver>.installer` to repo path or trusted `https://` URL. |
| **5** | Create `features.md` & `changelog.md` | Provides product overview and release notes in Markdown. | Populates the **Features & Overview** and **Release Changelog** tabs. | Sanitized with Marked.js + DOMPurify on `/app/<slug>`. |
| **6** | Register Repo URL in `registry.json` | Adds `"https://github.com/owner/repo"` to `vib-apps-hub`. | Connects the repository to `apps.vib.tools` & `get.vib.tools`. | Auto-collected within 5 minutes (300s Edge TTL). |

---

## 3. Hard Frozen Schema Invariants (`schemaVersion: 1` — HTTP 422 on Violation)

- **Closed Contract (`additionalProperties: false`):** Zero custom or misspelled keys allowed on root or inside `versions.<ver>`.
  - **Exact Allowed Root Keys:** `$schema`, `schemaVersion`, `slug`, `name`, `tagline`, `category`, `access`, `icon`, `latest`, `installer`, `docs`, `platforms`, `architectures`, `requirements`, `screenshots`, `links`, `versions`
  - **Exact Allowed Version Keys:** `url`, `installer`, `size`, `sha256`, `released_at`, `channel`, `deprecated`
- **Required Root Fields:** `slug`, `name`, `latest`, `versions` (plus always set `"$schema": "https://apps.vib.tools/schemas/vibtools-app.schema.json"` and `"schemaVersion": 1`).
- **`slug`:** Strictly lowercase `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-_]{0,63}$`.
- **`name`:** 1–80 chars. **`tagline`:** 1–160 chars. **`category`:** 1–48 chars. **`access`:** `"Free"` or `"Paid"`.
- **`latest`:** MUST match an EXACT own key in `versions` (e.g. `"v1.0.3"` === `"v1.0.3"`).
- **Version Keys:** MUST match `^[vV]?[0-9][0-9A-Za-z._+-]{0,47}$` (digit required after optional `v`; prototype names like `constructor` are forbidden).
- **`url` (Required per version):** Valid `https://` URL on a trusted binary host:
  - Default trusted binary hosts: `dl.vib.tools`, `github.com`, `objects.githubusercontent.com`, `release-assets.githubusercontent.com` (plus `env.ALLOWED_DOWNLOAD_HOSTS`).
  - Default trusted remote installer hosts: all above + `raw.githubusercontent.com`.
- **`released_at`:** Real calendar ISO date `"YYYY-MM-DD"` (impossible dates like `"2026-02-31"` return `422`; NEVER use `"releaseDate"`).
- **`sha256`:** Exact 64-character hex string `^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$` (omit until real binary hash is known; NEVER write `"TBD"`).
- **`size`:** 1–32 chars (e.g. `"42.8 MB"`). **`channel`:** `"stable" | "beta" | "alpha"`. **`deprecated`:** boolean.
- **`icon`, `screenshots`, `links`:** Must be valid `https://` URLs with a hostname.
- **`platforms`, `architectures`:** Unique non-empty string arrays (`uniqueItems: true`).
- **`requirements`:** Non-empty string array (`minItems: 1`) or non-empty string key-value map.
- **`installer` (root or per-version):** Safe repo-relative path (no `..`, no non-HTTPS scheme), trusted `https://` URL, or `{ "type": "powershell"|"bash"|"sh"|"cmd", "script": "..." }`.
- **`docs`:** `{ "features"?: "...", "changelog"?: "..." }` — safe repo-relative paths only (no `..` traversal, no URI schemes like `http://`/`https://`).

---

## 4. Canonical Templates (Copy & Fill Real Repository Values)

### A. `.vibtools/apps/app.config.json`
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://apps.vib.tools/schemas/vibtools-app.schema.json",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "slug": "calgrid",
  "name": "CalGrid",
  "tagline": "Minimalist desktop calendar widget and event scheduler",
  "category": "Productivity",
  "access": "Free",
  "icon": "https://dl.vib.tools/calgrid/icon.png",
  "latest": "v1.1.0",
  "installer": {
    "type": "powershell",
    "script": ".vibtools/apps/installer.ps1"
  },
  "docs": {
    "features": ".vibtools/apps/features.md",
    "changelog": ".vibtools/apps/changelog.md"
  },
  "platforms": ["Windows 10/11"],
  "architectures": ["x64"],
  "requirements": [
    "Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)",
    "PowerShell 5.1 or PowerShell 7+"
  ],
  "links": {
    "docs": "https://docs.vib.tools/calgrid",
    "source": "https://github.com/vib-tools/calgrid"
  },
  "versions": {
    "v1.1.0": {
      "url": "https://dl.vib.tools/calgrid/v1.1.0/CalGrid-Setup-1.1.0.exe",
      "size": "43.2 MB",
      "sha256": "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855",
      "released_at": "2026-11-15",
      "channel": "stable"
    },
    "v1.0.2": {
      "url": "https://dl.vib.tools/calgrid/v1.0.2/CalGrid-Setup-1.0.2.exe",
      "installer": "https://dl.vib.tools/calgrid/v1.0.2/install-legacy.ps1",
      "size": "41.5 MB",
      "released_at": "2026-10-28",
      "deprecated": true
    }
  }
}
```

### B. `.vibtools/apps/installer.ps1`
```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# Injected automatically by get.vib.tools: $APP_SLUG, $APP_VERSION, $APP_NAME
if (-not $APP_SLUG) { $APP_SLUG = "calgrid" }
if (-not $APP_VERSION) { $APP_VERSION = "v1.1.0" }
if (-not $APP_NAME) { $APP_NAME = "CalGrid" }

$DownloadUrl = "https://get.vib.tools/dl/$APP_SLUG/$APP_VERSION"
$TempFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP "$APP_SLUG-$APP_VERSION-setup.exe"

Write-Host "==> Downloading $APP_NAME ($APP_VERSION)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
try {
    Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $DownloadUrl -OutFile $TempFile -UseBasicParsing
    $Hash = (Get-FileHash -Path $TempFile -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    Write-Host "==> SHA256: $Hash" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    Write-Host "==> Launching installer..." -ForegroundColor Green
    Start-Process -FilePath $TempFile -Wait
} catch {
    Write-Error "Failed to install $APP_NAME ($APP_VERSION): $_"
    exit 1
} finally {
    if (Test-Path $TempFile) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TempFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}
Write-Host "==> $APP_NAME ($APP_VERSION) installed." -ForegroundColor Green
```

### C. `.vibtools/apps/features.md`
```markdown
# CalGrid

Minimalist desktop calendar widget and event scheduler built for low-overhead daily planning.

## Key Highlights
- Instant desktop overlay with keyboard navigation
- Local-first event storage with zero background bloat
- Native dark and light theme parity

## Quick Install
```powershell
irm "https://get.vib.tools/calgrid" | iex
```
```

```markdown
# Release Changelog

## v1.1.0 (2026-11-15)
- **Added:** Keyboard quick-add dialog for recurring reminders
- **Fixed:** High-DPI scaling alignment on multi-monitor setups

## v1.0.2 (2026-10-28)
- **Fixed:** Startup tray icon refresh after Windows sleep wake
```

```json
[
  "https://github.com/owner/repo"
]
```

---

## 5. Mandatory 12-Point Self-Verification Checklist
1. `.vibtools/apps/app.config.json` parses as strict UTF-8 JSON (no comments, no trailing commas).
2. `"$schema"` is `"https://apps.vib.tools/schemas/vibtools-app.schema.json"` and `"schemaVersion"` is `1`.
3. Every root key and version key is in the exact frozen list (zero unknown keys).
4. `"slug"` is strictly lowercase matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-_]{0,63}$`.
5. `"latest"` matches an EXACT own key in `"versions"`.
6. Every version key starts with a digit after optional `v`.
7. Every version `"url"` is a valid `https://` URL on a trusted binary host.
8. Every `"released_at"` is a real calendar `"YYYY-MM-DD"` date (never `"releaseDate"`).
9. Every `"sha256"` (if included) is an exact 64-character hex string.
10. Root/per-version `"installer"` and `"docs"` paths have zero `..` traversal and valid path/HTTPS rules.
11. The active master installer script (R2 HTTPS URL or `.vibtools/apps/installer.ps1`, UTF-8 without BOM) dynamically uses `$APP_SLUG`, `$APP_VERSION`, and `$APP_NAME`.
12. `.vibtools/apps/features.md` and `.vibtools/apps/changelog.md` exist with clean Markdown and zero unsafe raw HTML.
